scientific.integrity: The proof is an exact elimination from the two printed prey equilibrium equations. A bundled symbolic checker reconstructs the quadratic and verifies exact feasible and infeasible parameter examples. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns only predator-free endemic equilibria of the printed 2024 model. It does not assess the interior equilibrium or Hopf calculations, and it does not infer what unpublished implementation code may have used.

title: The predator-free endemic branch is quadratic and unique in a delayed eco-epidemic model
